svg.title: Indicative memory placement on the existing mainboard
svg.desc: A conservative, unrouted four-device placement concept based on the native board footprints and assembly envelopes. The second snapshot SRAM is far from the other devices and is not a preferred layout. This does not establish electrical or mechanical qualification.
svg.text: Mainboard memory placement — preliminary space study
Existing board and case geometry; four added memories are candidates, not routed or installed components.
Candidate V2 is distant from V1.
It is not a preferred placement:
and signal timing are not shown.
full assembly fit is not shown.
Nominal board 220 × 150 mm. Study uses the existing layout, cooler and represented assembly regions.
One millimetre XY margin is used for the candidate-envelope comparison; this is not a design-rule or fit qualification.
